title: Fix popup dialogs not appearing if pushed when `OverlayActivationMode` is wrong

target.summary: Checking `OverlayActivationMode.Value == OverlayActivation.All` prevents dialogs from appearing when the activation mode is `UserTriggered`. This causes user-initiated dialogs (such as resetting skin settings or deleting a skin while paused) to fail to display.
notes: faulty check requiring OverlayActivation.All instead of allowing UserTriggered
definition of the IsPresent property whose behavior is wrong
